messages:
jess_support: FYI customer (Acme) reporting doubled token billing + 800ms p50 since last week. They say a single user request spawned requests to 3 regions. Sample: \u2018one API call -> billed 3x tokens\u2019. Need quick triage.

mike_runtime: Can you paste a raw request/headers and an example request id? looking for routing headers and whether our router triggered fallback.

jess_support: From their logs (redacted):
```
POST /v1/generate
Host: api.redwood.example
Authorization: Bearer sk_live_***
X-Request-Id: acme-req-20240315-77
X-Forwarded-For: 34.82.10.9
User-Agent: AcmeApp/2.1
```
They included our SDK metadata: 
```
{"client":"redwood-js","version":"1.4.0","regionHint":"eu-central-1","requestMode":"hedged"}
```
They also attached a tiny trace where our router returned a 502 from eu then retried against us-east and ap-southeast.

ana_network: If the SDK is hedging across fallbackRegions, that can cause cross-region fanout. Does the SDK version you mentioned (1.4.0) use hedged requests by default?

sam_devex: 1.4.0 default is hedgedRequests: true for low-latency mode but hedgedAcrossRegions was supposed to be false. We shipped a bug in 1.4.0 where fallbackRegions were used for hedging instead of only for sequential failover. Repro is simple.

tess_sre: That explains spikes & billing. If hedged requests went to three regions simultaneously and all advanced tokens, they would be billed for each generated token chunk until routing dropped duplicates.

jess_support: Customer gave timeline: first call -> 200ms no body -> client hedged -> two more requests -> all returned partial chunks -> final merge. They saw ~300 tokens billed x3.

mike_runtime: Need exact repro steps from SDK. sam, can you paste the minimal config that triggers the bug?

sam_devex: Minimal snippet (JS):
```js
const client = new RedwoodClient({
  apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY,
  region: 'eu-central-1',
  fallbackRegions: ['us-east-1','ap-southeast-1'],
  lowLatencyMode: true, // enables hedgedRequests
  hedgedAcrossRegions: false // intended default, but 1.4.0 ignores this
})
await client.generate({prompt: 'hi', maxTokens: 200})
```
In 1.4.0, hedgedAcrossRegions is not respected due to a router map bug: we build hedgedEndpoints = fallbackRegions.concat(primary) instead of checking hedgedAcrossRegions.

ana_network: Ops-probable mitigation: force regional pinning in the control plane per API key until SDK patch. We can add a header that our router honors: `X-Redwood-Pin-Region: true` that prevents hedging across regions. Jess, can you ask Acme to set a custom header or to pin region in their SDK config?

jess_support: Sent customer suggested short-term workarounds: 1) pin region in SDK (client.region = 'eu-central-1') 2) set env var REDWOOD_HEDGED=false 3) include header `X-Redwood-Pin-Region: true` in requests. Waiting on confirmation.

mike_runtime: I'll push a temporary router-side safety: if request metadata indicates hedgedRequests and origin regionHint present, do not fanout to fallbackRegions for 24h for affected API keys. Need approval from tess_sre for a scoped rule.

ops-bot: deploy scheduled: route-safety-20240315 -> canary -> 3 nodes.

tess_sre: Approve scoped routing guard for customer API keys with high hedged fanouts. Add audit log and expiry TTL. Coordinate with infra to avoid global perf regressions.

sam_devex: I'll prepare a 1.4.1 patch that fixes hedgedAcrossRegions handling and add an integration test that asserts hedging routes only to same-region endpoints when flagged. Also will publish a migration note.

jess_support: Customer confirmed they can toggle REDWOOD_HEDGED=false for now and wants ETA for SDK patch and reimbursement for overbilled tokens.

mike_runtime: ETA: router hotfix in 30m to block fanout for affected keys, SDK patch PR open (link) -> staging tests in 2h, release 1.4.1 in next patch window (4-6h). Billing: support to open refund ticket.

jess_support: Opening billing ticket now. cc @tess_sre for audit.

sam_devex: Repro commands I'm using locally to simulate:
```
# simulate latency in eu to trigger hedging
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_test" -H "X-Redwood-Meta: {\"requestMode\":\"hedged\"}" \
  https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"x","max_tokens":200}'
```
You can also force region hint: `-H 'X-Redwood-Region: eu-central-1'`.

ana_network: After router guard is applied, let's run a small smoke across eu/us/ap to ensure no regression in single-region failover. I'll run canary tests.

tess_sre: Also capture braindead cases: SDK might still emit concurrent retries when upstream returns 5xx rapidly. Make sure router guard looks for concurrent inbound attempts from same request id and dedups tokens.

jess_support: Customer appreciated quick action, will wait for routing guard and SDK patch. They asked us to include a short repro they can run; pasted above.

mike_runtime: I'll follow up once guard is live and confirm the API keys affected. Good catch team. :thumbsup:

acme_webhook: (external) thanks for the quick replies — toggled REDWOOD_HEDGED=false and latency improved. Will wait on refund.

jess_support: Closing internal triage thread. Will update billing ticket when refunded.
